record.paper_title: Selected Conjectures and Open Problems on Directed Graphs
record.context_brief: weighted and multigraph directed cut exponent
record.original_question: For acyclic directed multigraphs and weighted acyclic digraphs whose arc weights are at least 1, determine the exact asymptotic exponent for the error term above one quarter of the total arc count or total arc weight, closing the known gap between upper exponent 3/4 and lower exponent 3/5 for the corresponding functions h_mu and h_omega.

evidence.quote: Very recently, Ai et al. [4] extended Alon’s results to acyclic directed multigraphs and weighted acyclic digraphs.
let Dω be the set of weighted digraphs in which every arc has weight at least 1
As we can see there is still a gap between 3 4 and 3 5 . Thus, it is natural to ask for the exact value.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A directed cut in a digraph $D=(V,A)$ is the set of arcs from $S$ to $V\setminus S$ for some $S\subseteq V$. For an acyclic directed multigraph $D$ with $m$ arcs (parallel arcs allowed), let $\mathrm{mc}(D)$ denote the maximum number of arcs in a directed cut of $D$, and define
$$h_\mu(m) = \min\{\mathrm{mc}(D) : D \text{ is an acyclic directed multigraph with } m \text{ arcs}\}.$$
For a weighted acyclic digraph $D$ with arc weight function $\omega:A\to[1,\infty)$ and total weight $w=\sum_{a\in A}\omega(a)$, let $\mathrm{mc}_\omega(D)$ denote the maximum total weight of a directed cut, and define
$$h_\omega(w) = \min\{\mathrm{mc}_\omega(D) : D \text{ is a weighted acyclic digraph with arc weights} \ge 1 \text{ and total weight } w\}.$$
It is known that
$$\tfrac{m}{4} + \Omega(m^{3/5}) \le h_\mu(m) \le \tfrac{m}{4} + O(m^{3/4}), \qquad \tfrac{w}{4} + \Omega(w^{3/5}) \le h_\omega(w) \le \tfrac{w}{4} + O(w^{3/4}).$$
Determine the exact asymptotic exponent $\alpha\in[3/5,\,3/4]$ such that $h_\mu(m) = m/4 + \Theta(m^\alpha)$ and $h_\omega(w) = w/4 + \Theta(w^\alpha)$.
artifact.status_search_result: The bounds $\tfrac{w}{4}+\Omega(w^{3/5})$ and $\tfrac{w}{4}+O(w^{3/4})$ for the weighted/multigraph versions were established by Ai, Gerke, Gutin and Mei (SIAM J. Discrete Math., on "Bounds on Maximum Weight Directed Cut"), who explicitly leave the exact exponent open. No subsequent work closing the gap was found, so the problem appears still open.

status_evidence.title: Bounds on Maximum Weight Directed Cut
status_evidence.snippet: h_ω(w) = w/4 + O(w^{3/4}) and h_ω(w) = w/4 + Ω(w^{3/5}); the asymptotic value of functions h, h_μ, and h_ω remains an interesting open problem.
status_evidence.claim: The gap between exponents 3/5 and 3/4 for h_μ and h_ω is explicitly stated as open.

status_evidence.title: Maximum directed cuts in acyclic digraphs (Alon, Bollobás, Gyárfás, Lehel, Scott)
status_evidence.snippet: Every acyclic digraph with m arcs has a directed cut of size m/4 + Ω(m^{4/5}); the infimum exponent lies in [3/5, 4/5].
status_evidence.claim: Original Alon et al. work giving the framework that was extended to multigraphs and weighted digraphs.
